caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed against a plain, light beige background. The chair is rendered in shades of brown, highlighting the natural texture and grain of the wood. The backrest of the chair is tall and features intricate carvings, including floral and geometric patterns, with a central arched panel flanked by decorative borders. The armrests are ornately shaped, with scroll-like curved ends and additional carved details. Four legs support the chair, with the front two being turned and more decorative, while the back legs are simpler and straight. The seat appears flat with a subtly textured surface, and the front rail underneath the seat is decorated with vertical grooves. The drawing focuses solely on the chair, with no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Wainscot Armchair
